fixed.summary: While the game plays on a page or a desktop window, `capture`, `capture_views` and `screenshot` show the frame the player sees next: drawn with the frame history (TAA, GI and reflection accumulation, exposure) at the display's render scale and graphics preset, so a TAA ghost or an automatic-quality blur shows in the capture. Where nothing is presented (`og run`, `og test`, `og render`) or a harness steps the frames (a web harness stepping `frame`, `og run --capture-only`) a capture is still a reference, a function of the scene alone at render scale 1, the same on every host. Every host now takes one capture path: the desktop window no longer captures at the automatic-quality scale in a script, and a capture also gets the frame's player graphics preset and loaded probe bakes.

A capture draws every texture in its frame, past the web's per-frame upload budget. A page whose GPU device was lost and made again captured its first frames' 1×1 stand-ins instead: a style pack's art (Button, Chip, Plate and Panel frames, a plain `<Image>`) was missing from the capture while the backdrop drew.
